Container.Name: pegasus-hub
Container.Overview: Runs Unfolded Circle Remote integrations on your server and links them to the remote through the Pegasus Bridge, so they don't use the remote's install slots or battery. Host networking lets integrations find devices on your network.

Config.Name: Data folder
Config.Description: Integrations, their settings and logs, pairing code and history. Back this up.

Config.Name: Port
Config.Description: Port of the hub page and of the remotes' link.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User the integrations run as (Unraid: 99 = nobody).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group the integrations run as (Unraid: 100 = users).

Config.Name: Time zone
Config.Description: For logs and charts, e.g. America/New_York.

Config.Name: Page password
Config.Description: Optional login for the hub page. Remotes use the pairing code.

Config.Name: Hub address
Config.Description: Only if the page shows a wrong hub address (bridge networking): the server's LAN address.
